requirements.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:13 matches the contract `send(string $title, string $message, array $context = []): void`. Lines 16-20 make a missing or blank URL a no-op with no HTTP call. Lines 35-37 call `Http::timeout(5)->post($webhookUrl, ['content' => $text])`. Lines 22-28 build title/message/`key=value` lines, and lines 30-32 truncate multibyte-safely with mb_substr to 1800 characters. Redaction covers sensitive keys (lines 130-146), Bearer strings (148-151) and nested arrays rendered as JSON (73-77, 98-127). Non-2xx responses (46-50) and transport exceptions (38-44) are logged at error level with the URL scrubbed. config/services.php:38-40 adds `discord.webhook_url`. config/logging.php:57 sets the stack default to `daily` and lines 76-82 add the audit channel (daily driver, audit.log, info, 90). phpunit.xml:32 pins LOG_STACK and .env.example adds every env key. The `daily` channel is not in the diff; this assumes the existing framework default already has `days` => env('LOG_DAILY_DAYS', 14). One small gap: a non-array object in the context is json_encoded without redaction (lines 90-92).

conventions.evidence: The conventions require 'No production code without a test; everything implemented ships with a test', and the diff adds no test file. Docs are kept in sync (docs/ops/logging.md, CHANGELOG.md under [Unreleased]). The public `send()` method has no PHPDoc. Placing the service class in app/Ops is dictated by the task, so it does not breach the no-service-layer rule.

security.evidence: Redaction runs recursively over nested arrays (DiscordOpsAlert.php:98-127). Exception messages are scrubbed of the full URL, the URL without its scheme, its path and its basename, and then any `https?://` URL (lines 153-193), so the webhook token cannot reach the logs. The non-2xx log entry contains only the status code (line 48). Limited gap: an object value such as stdClass or a JsonSerializable carrying a `token` field is json_encoded unredacted (lines 90-92). There is no user-facing input or authorization surface.

tests.evidence: The diff contains no Pest or PHPUnit test. Nothing covers the no-op path, the payload format, 1800-character truncation, redaction, soft-fail logging, URL scrubbing or the logging config contract, even though the task spells all of these out as testable requirements.

simplicity.evidence: renderValue (lines 63-93) and redactArray (lines 98-127) repeat the same sensitive-key and Bearer checks. scrub (lines 153-193) uses four layers of str_replace plus a catch-all URL regex, where the final regex combined with replacing the full URL would be enough. The outer try/catch with a nested try/catch around Log (lines 51-59) is defensive but adds bulk.

readability.evidence: Names are clear and methods are small and private. The 'Belt and braces' comment explains the URL regex. scrub is harder to follow than it needs to be, and the nested try blocks in send make the control flow somewhat dense. There is no debug output or dead code.

scope.evidence: Every touched file (.env.example, CHANGELOG.md, app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php, config/logging.php, config/services.php, docs/ops/logging.md, phpunit.xml) serves the task. The notifier is not wired into any job or handler, which matches the out-of-scope list.

issues.explanation: The change ships no tests for the notifier or the logging config, which breaks the project's mandatory TDD rule and leaves truncation, redaction, soft-fail and URL-scrubbing behaviour unverified.
Object context values are json_encoded without passing through redaction, so an object with a token or password property would leak into the Discord payload.

scrub() layers several str_replace passes (full URL, URL without scheme, path, basename) before a catch-all URL regex. This is more machinery than needed, and replacing the path basename could over-redact unrelated text.
The sensitive-key and Bearer checks are duplicated between renderValue() and redactArray() instead of sharing one per-value redaction helper.
The new public send() method has no PHPDoc, although the conventions ask for PHPDoc on public methods that are touched.
The daily channel is not in the diff, so `days` => env('LOG_DAILY_DAYS', 14) relies on an existing default that cannot be confirmed from the change.

review.summary: The change adds a soft-failing DiscordOpsAlert with key/Bearer redaction, multibyte truncation and webhook-URL scrubbing, plus the audit channel, the daily stack default, the env keys and a clear logging decision guide. The implementation appears to meet the functional contract, but it ships no tests at all, which violates the project's mandatory TDD convention, and the redaction and scrubbing code is more duplicated and convoluted than it needs to be. It needs tests before merging.
